name: RC Metal Works Inc
old_description: At RC Metalworks, we are specialists in sheet metal fabrication and ductwork for commercial and industrial HVAC systems. Our experienced craftsman can fabricate ductwork and other custom metalwork from galvanized steel, aluminum, stainless steel, black iron, copper, and lead coated copper. Our clients, located in Rhode Island (RI), Massachusetts (MA), and Connecticut (CT), include hospitals, universities, laboratories, governments, commercial developments, residential developments, and heavy industry.
about:
RC Metal Works Inc, doing business as RC Metalworks, operates from Johnston, Rhode Island. The company has delivered sheet metal fabrication and ductwork services since 1987, focusing on commercial and industrial HVAC systems.

The shop fabricates ductwork and custom metal components from galvanized steel, aluminum, stainless steel, black iron, copper, and lead-coated copper. Its capabilities include SMACNA-standard ductwork, custom sheet metal orders, ductwork installation, and repair services for all metal types. The team handles projects ranging from standard air ducts to custom panels, drain pans, machine guards, cupola covers, and steel frames, working from customer sketches or specifications.

Clients span hospitals, universities, laboratories, government facilities, commercial and residential developments, and heavy industry across Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut. The company coordinates installation and repairs around operating hours to minimize disruption for facilities such as hospitals and universities.

RC Metalworks emphasizes craftsmanship, precision, and deep HVAC expertise. All ductwork is fabricated to SMACNA standards with a full review of fabrication quality, sealing, fit, and structural integrity before completion. Post-installation airflow testing and adjustment ensure long-term performance.
